title: Bar Series Desserts Blueberry Swirl 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Bar Series Desserts Blueberry Swirl is a decadent treat for vapers who enjoy a rich, dessert-inspired vape. The profile opens with the lush, juicy taste of ripe Blueberries, providing a naturally sweet fruit foundation. This is elegantly swirled with smooth, velvety notes of Cheesecake and rich Cream on the exhale, creating a balanced and indulgent flavour experience that is satisfying without being overly heavy. Formulated with a balanced 50% VG / 50% PG ratio, this Nic Salt e-liquid offers excellent versatility. It is suitable for use in standard MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) starter kits as well as RDL (Restricted Direct-to-Lung) pod devices, performing optimally with coils ranging from 1.2ohm to 0.6ohm. The Nicotine Salt formulation ensures a silky-smooth throat hit and rapid satisfaction, available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths. The Bar Series Desserts collection is designed to deliver high-impact flavour. These UK-made e-liquids utilise extra-concentrated ingredients to provide a bold, "bar-style" taste profile in a refillable format. Whether you prefer fruity, icy, or dessert blends, Bar Series offers a robust vaping experience for every palate.
